occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated in regards to a report and found deficient. An infant was given the wrong bottle when a caregiver failed to properly check the label.

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: Two of the children records do not have a health statement or signed affidavit on file within week of enrollment.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: A caregiver does not have CPR/First Aid trainings on file to review.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Special Diets - Employees given information (26 TAC §746.3311(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Orientation-Prevention & responding to allergic reactions: The operations orientation does not include preventing and responding to allergic reactions.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated in regards to a report and found deficient. A careful failed to follow proper policies and procedures and fed one infant another infants formula.    It was also determined a caregiver was blowing in infants faces to force them to sleep or calm down.
